basic_profile.bio: I am a computational scientist based in Halifax, Canada, with a keen interest in emerging technologies and sustainable solutions. I have a strong background in computer science, having completed my Master's at Dalhousie University. I enjoy hiking in the beautiful landscapes of Nova Scotia, and I'm an avid reader of both fiction and non-fiction, particularly Indian literature. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, and I work as a data analyst for a tech company. I'm currently single and enjoy spending weekends exploring new coffee shops. I'm a big fan of Ember mugs for keeping my coffee at the perfect temperature.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I possess a comprehensive understanding of computational science, gained through formal education and hands-on experience in data analysis and software development. My expertise is further enriched by my active participation in online forums and self-study of recent technological advancements.
